newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: NatSteel, Hiap Moh in project.
newsitem.headline: NatSteel, Hiap Moh in project.

text.p: NatSteel Ltd and Hiap Moh Corporation Ltd said on Thursday that a consortium led by NatSteel Properties Pte Ltd, was buying a prime residential land in Sydney, Australia and developing it for about A$100 million.
The freehold land, located in Sydney's central business district, would be developed into 320 upmarket residential and serviced apartments, said a joint statement from NatSteel and Hiap Moh.
The other member of the consortium is Supreme Diamonds Ltd.
NatSteel has a 60 percent equity stake in the consortium which is held through a Singapore subsidiary, Sydney Cove Property Pte Ltd.
Hiap Moh has a 25 percent stake and Supreme Diamonds, a 15 percent stake.
The site is owned by the St Patrick's Church of Sydney.
The acquisition, to be funded by internal resources and bank borrowings, is not expected to have a significant impact on earnings of NatSteel or Hiap Moh in the current year, the statement said.
